chk_run_steps_usage.name: chk_run_steps_usage
chk_run_steps_usage.value: "run_steps"."tokens_used" >= 0 AND "run_steps"."requests_used" >= 0 AND "run_steps"."cost_micros" >= 0 AND ("run_steps"."duration_ms" IS NULL OR "run_steps"."duration_ms" >= 0)

chk_files_source_owner.name: chk_files_source_owner
chk_files_source_owner.value:
(
        ("files"."source" = 'drive' AND "files"."scope" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."session_id" IS NULL AND "files"."run_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("files"."source" IN ('chat_upload', 'chat_output') AND "files"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."scope" IS NULL AND "files"."folder_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("files"."source" = 'run' AND "files"."run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."scope" IS NULL AND "files"."folder_id" IS NULL AND "files"."session_id" IS NULL)
      )

chk_budgets_period.name: chk_budgets_period
chk_budgets_period.value: ("budgets"."kind" = 'limit' AND "budgets"."period_start" IS NULL AND "budgets"."period_end" IS NULL) OR ("budgets"."kind" = 'account' AND "budgets"."period_end" > "budgets"."period_start")

chk_prices_nonnegative.name: chk_prices_nonnegative
chk_prices_nonnegative.value: COALESCE("prices"."input_per_mtok", 0) >= 0 AND COALESCE("prices"."output_per_mtok", 0) >= 0 AND COALESCE("prices"."cached_input_per_mtok", 0) >= 0 AND COALESCE("prices"."unit_price", 0) >= 0

chk_mcp_connectors_owner.name: chk_mcp_connectors_owner
chk_mcp_connectors_owner.value: ("mcp_connectors"."scope" = 'personal' AND "mcp_connectors"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("mcp_connectors"."scope" = 'team' AND "mcp_connectors"."owner_user_id" IS NULL)
